root.name: アプライド・デジタル

rows.ja: 供給元(電力・発電設備)

relations.text: ノースダコタ州エレンデールのデータセンターに2023年3月から電力を供給。さらに350MW分の電力供給契約も州当局が承認
relations.text_en: Has powered the Ellendale, North Dakota data center since March 2023; a service agreement for another 350 MW of load was approved by the state regulator

source.label: MDU Resources 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In March 2023, the Company began to provide power for Applied Digital's data center near Ellendale, North Dakota.

companies.name: バブコック・アンド・ウィルコックス

relations.text: B&Wの株式とワラントを取得。B&Wは提携先Base Electronの約1.2GWガス発電所の設計・建設を請け負う
relations.text_en: Bought B&W shares and warrants; B&W is the design-build contractor for partner Base Electron’s ~1.2 GW gas-fired plant

source.label: Babcock & Wilcox 8-K添付書類(2025年12月)
source.quote: the Company shall issue to Applied Digital 500,000 shares of Common Stock (the "Shares") for a purchase price of $2,000,000
source.note: ワラントの一部は2026年3月にBase Electronへ譲渡されました。
source.note_en: Part of the warrant right was assigned to Base Electron in March 2026.

relations.text: Base ElectronとB&Wの設計・建設契約(約1.2GWの発電所)について、Applied Digitalが履行を保証していた
relations.text_en: Applied Digital guaranteed Base Electron’s obligations under its design-build agreement with B&W for a ~1.2 GW power plant

source.label: Applied Digital 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: The Company was party to a Guarantee (the "Guarantee") in favor of The Babcock & Wilcox Company ("B&W")
source.note: 保証は過去形で書かれています。
source.note_en: The filing describes the guarantee in the past tense.

relations.text: ノースダコタ州Polaris Forge 1でCoreWeaveに計400MWを15年間リース(契約総額 約110億ドル)
relations.text_en: Leases a total of 400 MW at Polaris Forge 1 in North Dakota to CoreWeave for 15 years (about $11.0B contracted)

source.label: Applied Digital 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: bringing the total contracted capacity at Polaris Forge 1 under our CoreWeave leases to 400 MW

relations.text: リース契約に合わせ、CoreWeaveに約1,306万株分のワラントを発行(その後、第三者へ譲渡)
relations.text_en: Issued CoreWeave a warrant for about 13.06M shares alongside the leases (later assigned to third parties)

source.label: Applied Digital 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: the Company issued to CoreWeave a warrant (the "CoreWeave Warrant") to acquire up to 13,062,521 shares

companies.name: マッコーリー・グループ

relations.text: Macquarie Asset Management傘下のファンドが、HPC(AIデータセンター)事業に優先出資
relations.text_en: Funds managed within Macquarie Asset Management invested in preferred equity of the HPC data center business

source.label: Applied Digital 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: entered into a Unit Purchase Agreement (the "Unit Purchase Agreement" or "UPA") for its HPC Hosting Business with MIP VI HPC Holdings, LLC, which is an affiliate of funds and investment vehicles managed by entities within Macquarie Asset Management

relations.text: Macquarie Equipment Capitalから開発資金の融資枠を受ける
relations.text_en: Macquarie Equipment Capital provides a development credit facility

source.label: Applied Digital 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: entered into an ongoing credit arrangement with MEC, for the purposes of funding the initial sourcing, planning

companies.name: 三井住友フィナンシャルグループ

relations.text: 三井住友銀行が事務代理人を務めた融資を、2025年11月の社債発行資金で完済
relations.text_en: Repaid in full a loan for which Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation was administrative agent, using November 2025 note proceeds

source.label: Applied Digital 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: the lenders party thereto and Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation ("SMBC"), as administrative agent
source.note: 融資は完済済みで、過去の関係です。
source.note_en: The loan has been repaid; a past relationship.

relations.text: 旧クラウド事業を分離したChronoScaleの株式の約97%を保有する子会社
relations.text_en: Owns about 97% of ChronoScale, which holds its former cloud business

source.label: Applied Digital 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: resulted in the Company owning approximately 97% of the issued and outstanding equity of ChronoScale Corporation

relations.text: 既存の大手データセンター事業者として、Equinixを競合に挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Equinix among established data center operators it competes with

source.label: Applied Digital 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: We compete with established data center owners and operators, including Digital Realty Trust, Inc. and Equinix, Inc.

relations.text: 既存の大手データセンター事業者として、Digital Realtyを競合に挙げる

source.label: Applied Digital 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: We compete with established data center owners and operators, including Digital Realty Trust, Inc. and Equinix, Inc.
